dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Building polygons
evidence_slice: Historic England Open Data Hub live NHLE FeatureServer layer 3 is named 'Listed Building polygons', has geometry type esriGeometryPolygon, supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF queries, and publishes ListEntry, Name, Grade, CaptureScale, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields. Copyright metadata states Crown Copyright 2026 and release under OGL. The selected layer metadata window does not itself expose a specific Exeter record or polygon coordinate payload.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer 3 is an official esriGeometryPolygon Listed Building polygons feature layer, but this metadata window contains no individual Exeter feature coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: The layer schema binds Name and Grade fields to ListEntry on each feature, but no individual Exeter record payload was exposed in this source window.
field_evidence.coverage: The live NHLE FeatureServer layer publishes nationwide Listed Building polygon coverage and supports JSON/GeoJSON/PBF query formats.
